map.由内压求环向（周向）应力 使用指南: Hoop (Circumferential) Stress from Internal Pressure User Guide
map.输入薄壁圆筒的内压 p、半径 r 与壁厚 t，按 σ_h=p·r/t 计算环向（: Enter the internal pressure p, radius r and wall thickness t of a thin-walled cylinder and compute the hoop (circumferential) stress as sigma_h = p*r/t; used to check the circumferential strength of pressurized pipes and vessels under internal pressure.
map.输入内压 p、半径 r、壁厚 t，求环向应力。: Enter the internal pressure p, radius r and wall thickness t to get the hoop stress.
map.薄壁圆筒（管道、容器）在内压下的环向应力。: Hoop stress in a thin-walled cylinder (pipe or vessel) under internal pressure.
map.压力容器壁厚初步设计。: Preliminary wall thickness design for pressure vessels.
map.与纵向应力联合评定。: Assessed together with the longitudinal stress.
map.：t 0.01→0.02：σh 减半为 50 MPa。: : t from 0.01 to 0.02: sigma_h halves to 50 MPa.
map.由直径求实心圆截面惯性矩: Second moment of area of a solid circular section from the diameter
map.由直径求实心圆截面极惯性矩: Polar second moment of area of a solid circular section from the diameter
map.环向与纵向哪个大？: Which is larger, hoop stress or longitudinal stress?
map.环向应力是纵向的 2 倍，筒体环向（环焊缝）更危险。: The hoop stress is twice the longitudinal one, so the hoop direction of the shell (the circumferential weld) is the more critical one.
map.一般 r/t>10 按薄壁公式，厚壁须用拉美公式。: Generally, r/t > 10 is handled with the thin-wall formula; thick walls require the Lame formula.
